diagnostics.title: Ranking hook settings push refused (live strategy unchanged)
diagnostics.summary: A pushed settings document for the ranking hook was refused (an unknown key, a non-string `policy`, or a strategy word the hook does not claim), so the push was NACKed and the hook keeps ranking by the strategy it already had. The reason is in the line.
diagnostics.action: Fix the named hook's settings (`policy` is one of cheapest, fastest, least_busy, usage; no other key) and reload the configuration.
